records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our net sales of $274.3 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2023 increased 8.3% from our net sales of $253.2 million for the second quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Although we have seen stabilization in truckload capacity and volume at U.S. ports, there is continued pressure on driver hiring and fuel and energy concerns due to continued unrest abroad.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The total value of inventories on hand at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2023 decreased $5.7 million, or 3.2%, in comparison to the total value of inventories on hand at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Due to significant inflation, including higher commodity acquisition costs in fiscal 2022, we have seen higher selling prices at retail.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Due to the factors discussed above, income from operations was $24.5 million, or 8.9% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2023 compared to $18.3 million, or 7.2% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2022.
